blocks.text: Python mein list square brackets se banti hai, cheezein commas se alag hoti hain. Text wali cheezein quotes mein hoti hain, aur print() list dikhata hai. Baad mein cheezein jori ya hatayi ja sakti hain.

blocks.title: Python code (har .... ek 4-space indent hai)
blocks.text:
# Create a list of items
items = ["Decorations", "Snacks", "Cold drinks", "Plates", "Balloons"]
print(items)
Linked list aisi list hai jo nodes se banti hai, jahan har node qeemat aur agle node ka hawala rakhta hai (Did You Know).

blocks.prompt: items list mein kitni cheezein hain, aur items[0] kya hai?

items: [ ] aur commas se list banayein; print() dikhata hai.
